digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Thursday, October 15 has nine live meetings, one protected work block, nine selected carry-over actions, and two overlapping afternoon meeting clusters. The day turns on unblocking Amazon Connect after voicemail routing stopped Denver and the Austin/Houston wave, landing the Attorney Review launch decision, and using the 1:30 PM Operations Portfolio Review to clear Phase I, Phase II, and Court risks. Five downward reviews are due today, while the critical Supabase security finding remains open. Dashboard state has not refreshed since October 8, so some unchecked work may already be complete.

items.label: Unblock Amazon Connect voicemail routing and reset the rollout
items.detail: Voicemail access is confirmed as a blocker across all users, Salesforce support has not produced an update, and Denver plus Austin/Houston testing are on hold. Use the 10:30 AM standup to set the recovery path, confirm Wave 1 language-skill coverage, and recognize Dolapo's Client Experience Tooling team as the new Product owner.

items.label: Land the Attorney Review launch decision
items.detail: The ticket workflow and dedicated intake-review queue are now documented. At the 2:30 PM checkpoint, confirm whether routing, attorney assignment, scripts, and escalation coverage are ready for today's planned go-live, then name any remaining owner.

items.label: Submit the five downward reviews due today
items.detail: Use the noon protected block to finish and submit all five reviews before the afternoon meeting run; collect any final prior-manager input first.

items.label: Resolve the critical Supabase row-level-security finding
items.detail: Validate the affected public table and restore the intended policy. The reported exposure could allow unauthenticated read, edit, and delete access and remains the day's highest security risk.

items.label: Set the short- and long-term path for Salesforce banners
items.detail: Stakeholders are aligned on a low-effort no-IT fix first, with the broader 56-banner inventory moving through Product and Litify-roadmap prioritization. Confirm scope owners and include an explanation wherever a banner tells staff not to contact a client.

items.label: Secure Legal review capacity for EKM scripts
items.detail: Confirm the Legal owner, capacity, and priority for the script-review queue before it delays the EKM migration or Agentforce readiness.

items.label: Close the lawsuit-readiness document request
items.detail: Verify that Monday's process-map and supporting links satisfy Kris's request, then send any missing SOPs, policies, training materials, or folder locations.

items.label: Set the Product path for Mental Health Evaluation expansion
items.detail: Use today's portfolio review to confirm the process, system, and ownership work required before additional vendors can be cleared nationwide.

items.label: Decide the project path for Detention Prevention edge cases
items.detail: Separate operating guidance from changes that require Litify flows, training, SOPs, Legal alignment, and formal intake, then assign the next owner.

items.label: 10:00 AM - Astrid 1:1
items.detail: Use the opening anchor to surface portfolio risks and any decisions that need to enter the 1:30 PM review.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect standup
items.detail: Treat voicemail routing as the go-live gate. Leave with a Salesforce escalation owner, revised Denver and Austin/Houston timing, and clarity on Product ownership.

items.label: 11:30 AM - Armando 1:1
items.detail: Keep the conversation decision-focused before the noon work block.

items.label: Noon - Protected work block
items.detail: Reserve the hour for the five downward reviews and the Supabase security finding; the afternoon calendar has no comparable focus window.

items.label: 1:30 PM - Operations Portfolio Review
items.detail: Bring the highest-impact Phase I, Phase II, and Court decisions. The last half overlaps the 2:00 PM Knowledge Management assignment review, so delegate or shorten one conversation.

items.label: 2:30 PM - Attorney Review conflicts with Maria 1:1
items.detail: Choose coverage before lunch so the go-live decision is not lost and Maria's portfolio roadblocks still receive a clear follow-up.

items.label: 3:30 PM - Thiago 1:1
items.detail: Close Amazon Connect ownership, revised rollout timing, and unresolved Wave 1 questions before the team meeting.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Tudo Bem weekly meeting
items.detail: Use the final hour to align the team on project risks, owners, and decisions emerging from the day's portfolio reviews.

items.label: Assign coverage for the two afternoon meeting collisions
items.detail: Resolve the 1:30-2:30 PM Operations Portfolio and Knowledge Management overlap, then the 2:30 PM Attorney Review and Maria 1:1 conflict, before the noon work block ends.

items.label: Set the fix plan for the Grievances banner glitch
items.detail: The implementation is hiding the Matter Plan and Documents tabs. Confirm the behavior was not intended, route the issue to IT, and provide a repair timeline to the thread.

items.label: Laura is out through Friday
items.detail: Keep SMS, client-communications, Levelpath, and related dependencies with the coverage owners already in place.

items.label: 10:30 AM - Amazon Connect standup
items.detail: Review the voicemail escalation and reset Wave 1 testing and go-live dates if the blocker clears.

items.label: 11:00 AM - Cross-firm Lead Intake Product alignment
items.detail: Clarify Jean's role in the new service line and align it with the continuing-process intake scope.

items.label: Noon - Protected work block
items.detail: Preserve the hour before a compressed afternoon of management, intake, pipeline, and executive-status meetings.

items.label: 1:00 PM - EPMO Management conflicts with 1:30 PM CLIP touchpoint
items.detail: Choose coverage in advance; Jorge is out and Nadia is on PTO, which increases the need for explicit owners and written handoffs.

items.label: 2:30 PM - EPMO/IT project pipeline
items.detail: Bring prioritization changes, BA assignments, UAT status, and the Salesforce banner intake path.

items.label: 3:00 PM - Executive Project Status update
items.detail: Close the week by updating the executive deck with resolved blockers, changed launch dates, and named owners.
